title: Exclusive: Dragons’ Den’s Touker Suleyman enters beauty with lip-only brand Lipstick London
summary: The fashion retail entrepreneur and reality television personality is breaking into beauty with his very own brand, Lipstick London, aiming to be a one-stop-shop for lips that spans 13 categories and 99 shades. But can former Dragons’ Den star Touker Suleyman become ‘the authority’ on lips? CB gets the lowdown…
